description: Search LIVE remote jobs with real filters (stack keyword, country, minimum salary, seniority, date posted). Most remote jobs only hire in one country or region, so pass `country` (where the user lives) whenever you know it, and ask if you do not: results are then limited to roles that person can apply to. Returns live listings with canonical job-page URLs. Always present the job URL from the result — never invent or guess job links.

board.description: Which job board to search. Defaults to the board this server is installed from. frontend = remotefrontendjobs.com, backend = remotebackendjobs.com, java = remotejavajobs.com.

country.description: Country the user lives in, as an ISO code or English name, e.g. "IN", "Nigeria", "Brazil". Returns only jobs open to that country: worldwide roles plus roles that name the country or its region. Preferred over `regions`.

minSalaryYearly.description: Minimum yearly pay in USD, e.g. 120000. Optional.

postedWithin.description: Only jobs posted within this window. Default all.

query.description: Stack/keyword, e.g. react, python, spring. Optional.

regions.description: Comma-separated geo regions, e.g. "europe,asia". Strict: only explicitly tagged jobs. Optional.

seniorities.description: Comma-separated seniority buckets: junior, mid, senior, staff, lead, principal, executive. Optional.

name: search_jobs

country.description: ISO code the results were limited to, or null when not filtered by country.

geo.description: Where candidates must live, e.g. "US", "Europe". Null with worldwide=false means the posting does not say.

url.description: Canonical job page — always cite this.

title: Search remote jobs
